title: Control room camera challenge produces the 'I living' artifact
summary: Eric Bard tells of Control room camera challenge produces the 'I living' artifact, about Fugal era at Control room, Skinwalker Ranch, Utah, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

And upon examination, you see that that screen something had manipulated that image to pull letters together completely out of sequence, no explanation, pull them together in a millisecond to form the words I living.

as_told.title: Eric Bard's own account of challenging the phenomenon and the first screenshot

plain: Skinwalker Ranch is a property in Utah long known for reports of strange happenings. Eric Bard, who works there, says that one day in the ranch's control room he said out loud that this was stupid, then added, "If you got something you want to show me, show me. If you got something you want to tell me, tell me," and the very first camera screenshot afterwards showed letters that spelled "I living." The ranch's owner, Brandon Fugal, says that when they examined the image, something had pulled letters on the screen together out of order in a split second to form those words, which would suggest something there was answering.
